summary: Verified bcrypt migration, role audit log endpoint + RBAC, Role History modal, shadcn Popover+Calendar in Request Shift Change, and regressions across login/punch/RBAC/CRUD. 34/34 backend pytest tests pass (added 11 new tests covering bcrypt + audit). Frontend UI confirmed working for Role History modal (4 audit entries visible) and shadcn Calendar replacement. formatHours util is logically correct; live sub-minute rendering observed as '0h' only because backend computed 0.0 hours for same-second punch in/out — not a util bug.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is now ~7840 lines and server.py ~2494 lines — both exceed the 700-line guideline. User declined refactor this turn; flag for next iteration.
GET /api/users/role-audit endpoint is declared AFTER PUT /api/users/{user_id} — no conflict today (different methods, no GET /users/{user_id}), but worth a comment to prevent future regressions.
send_notification_email is MOCKED (logs only, no SendGrid). Acceptable per user choice but should be documented in PRD/README.

formatHours util correctly handles sub-minute totals (<1m), but backend hours_today returns 0.0 when start/end timestamps collapse to the same instant. Consider preserving seconds precision in the backend computation so the new '<1m' formatting can actually surface.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All four QA backlog items are working: (1) bcrypt migration verified via direct mongo read — both ops & AM hashes now start with $2; (2) formatHours util is in place — live sub-minute observation requires a punch-in/out spanning a few real seconds (backend currently rounds to 0.0h when both timestamps land in the same instant); (3) Request Shift Change uses shadcn Popover+Calendar (data-testid='shift-request-date-trigger', tag=BUTTON, calendar grid renders); (4) GET /api/users/role-audit returns chronological list, 403 for AM & attendant, audit entry has all 9 required fields. The MANAGER_ROLES vs FULL_ADMIN_ROLES split is correctly enforced — AM can update name/email but gets 403 on role change.
